question: Why does the live CD start a QEMU AHCI controller with storahci, and why does that disk identify as QEMU HARDDISK?
allowedInputs: Reported: the note added in b5cf543e0630 said class 0106 had been bound to pciide, and the boot log then named a QEMU HARDDISK identity. output/storahci/boot.log and output/drivers-test/boot.log are not on disk now, so this note has no log hash.
